resources.string: Reads only the background screen an agent is working on, never the screen you are using.
Start it so agents can operate this phone
Turn on remote access below to reach it from other networks
Agents can operate this phone now
When you finish, your AI agent can open and use the apps on this phone for you, on a screen you don\'t see, while you keep using the phone.
Send a short text to your agent
Let Miu Bridge use other apps
Android does not let one app operate another unless you switch that on yourself. Do it once, one action at a time; each one ticks itself when it is done.
This phone\'s Android version has no way to do this on the phone alone. A computer can do it with one command.
This step only works on Wi-Fi. Any Wi-Fi will do.
Find “Build number” (on some phones under “Software information”) and tap it 7 times.
When the phone says you are a developer, press Back until you are here again.
Tap the button below and scroll down to “Wireless debugging”.
When asked, tick “Always allow on this network” and tap Allow. Then come back here.
Tap the button below, then tap the words “Wireless debugging” (the words, not the switch).
Tap “Pair device with pairing code”. Six digits appear.
Stay on that page. A Miu Bridge notification drops down from the top: tap “Enter code” in it.
Type the six digits and send. If the notification is gone, swipe down from the top of the screen to find it.
It contains a token that works like a password for this phone. Send it only to your own agent.
Tap “Enter code” below and type them in
Before an agent uses your apps
Please read these three points. They are the real risks, not boilerplate.
Many apps\' terms forbid third-party tools from operating them automatically. Using Miu Bridge in such an app can get your account restricted or closed.
Agents act on your instructions, in your accounts. What they do there is your responsibility.
Do not have an agent pay, transfer money, place orders or delete data.
Some phones (HarmonyOS, Android 10 and earlier) have no wireless debugging. A computer can open the same door with one command.
On the phone, turn on USB debugging in Developer options.
Connect the phone to a computer with a cable, and tap Allow when the phone asks. The computer needs adb (Android platform-tools, a free download from Google).
Unplug the cable and tap Done below. When the phone asks to allow debugging once more, allow it.
This lasts until the phone restarts; after a restart, run the command again.
Miu Bridge is creating the background screen. If the phone asks whether to allow debugging, allow it.
Paste it to your agent as it is, like sending it a message: Muse, Instinct, Claude Code, Codex or any other. It tells the agent how to reach this phone.
Getting this phone an address that works from anywhere…

The text holds two addresses and the agent picks: a direct one for agents on this Wi-Fi, and one through Miu Bridge\'s relay for everywhere else, free for 1,000 agent actions a month. You can turn the relay off later under Remote access on the main page.
Couldn\'t get an address for other networks (%1$s). For now the text only works for an agent on this Wi-Fi.
Say this to your agent. When it acts on the phone, you will see it here.
Use Miu Bridge to open Settings on my phone and tell me the battery level.
Nothing shows on your screen while it works; it uses the background screen.
Connected. Your agent just used this phone.
Keeps working with the screen off
So it returns after a reboot
Works with any agent on any device: Claude Code, Codex, Muse, Instinct and more.

Send the full text to any agent: it holds the address, the token and the ways to use the phone (from scripts in the agent\'s own sandbox or as an MCP server; the agent decides, and the first two are end-to-end encrypted). If the agent then asks you to put the token in its credential store, come back and copy just the token.
Copied. Send it to your agent.
The token is the key to this phone. Give it only to agents you trust.
Sign in with your email so agents on other networks can reach this phone. The first sign-in creates your account.
Off. Turn it on for agents on other networks; no sign-up.
Tap to open the download page

Send anonymous usage data from tool calls on this phone: which tool, which app, whether it worked, the error code, and how long it took. It helps us find where agents get stuck. You can change this at any time in More.
Usage data never includes what is on the screen, screenshots, anything typed, links, your account or email. A random id is used instead of your account, and leaving deletes what was sent.
While you are in, agents can also write a short note when a tool did not do what its description says. They are told never to include screen content; you can read every note under More.
Anonymous usage data and agents\' notes about tools. Turning it off deletes what was sent.

Agents can open only the apps you tick, and no others. With nothing ticked, they cannot open any app.

Refuse requests through the relay that are not end-to-end encrypted. Agents then connect with the SDK or its local MCP server; the plain MCP address only works on this Wi-Fi.
